or 3n^2 – 51n + 156 = 0
or n^2 – 17n + 52 = 0
or (n – 4)(n – 13) = 0

or 3n^2 – 51n + 156 = 0
or n^2 – 17n + 52 = 0
or (n – 4)(n – 13) = 0
or n = 4 or 13
Both values of n are admissible. So, the number of terms is either 4 or 13.
